what_this_is: Everything a model here is not asked to explain, with the measurement that bounded it. Without this list, `the model does not account for that` and `the model is not required to account for that` read the same, and the second gets worked on as though it were the first.
why_it_has_to_be_written_down: The residual between a model and this unit contains the room, the converters, the unit's analogue output stage, two clocks that drift against each other, and the unit's own take-to-take wobble. None of those is a structure and none of them gets smaller by thinking about it. A project that treats the whole residual as its own is a project chasing the analogue, which has no end.

not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: Measured once by loopback, and available to divide out of any other reading.

not_chased.what: The room, the unit's idle output and the interface's own noise.
not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: The chain with nothing played reaches -110.6 dBFS on the unit's channel. Every band-profile run since records its own, as a level and as a profile, so a reading suspected of being the floor can be held against the floor's shape.

not_chased.what: The drift between the unit's clock and the interface's.
not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: Between -57 and +27 parts per million over seven seconds, which is why phase is read below 1 kHz and nowhere else, and why waveforms are never compared.

bound.why_structured: Read by a scorer rather than by a person: a floor that has to allow for the two clocks needs the number, and a number kept only in a sentence is one every reader retypes.

not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: Two takes of one note subtract to -56.7 dB, at the noise floor of the silence before the note. That is the floor of every comparison here and it is not a target: a model reaching it would be reproducing the unit's noise.
Under 10 parts per million over twenty seconds.

not_chased.what: Anything above the unit's output band.
not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: 31.9 dB over silence at 16 kHz, 16.3 at 17, nothing at 18. A model is not asked what it does there and a reading is not taken there.

not_chased.what: Which printed label goes with which measured state.
not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: Not a measurable quantity at all. A corner byte with two states has two measured corners; which of them the manual calls 200 and which 400 is a question about a page.

not_chased.what: Whether this individual unit is representative of the model.
not_chased.how_it_was_bounded: Not bounded. One unit is measured and every claim here is scoped to it. A second unit would answer this and there is not one.

what_would_move_something_off_this_list: A residual that leans in a way one of these could not produce. The room does not grow with the setting of a byte; the converters do not change shape when a width byte moves. A lean that tracks a parameter is a structure, and structures are chased.
